description: This file defines the implementation of the torch library registration system, including classes and methods for defining, registering, and managing operators and their schemas within the PyTorch framework.

classes.name: CppFunction
classes.description: Represents a C++ kernel function with optional signature and schema.

classes.name: Library
classes.description: Manages registration and definition of operators, schemas, and implementations within the PyTorch library system.

methods.name: Library::reset
methods.description: Clears all registered operators and schemas.

methods.name: Library::_def
methods.description: Defines a new operator schema and registers it, with options for verification.

methods.name: Library::_def (overload)
methods.description: Defines an operator with a given schema or name, registers its implementation, and handles schema inference.

methods.name: Library::_impl
methods.description: Registers an implementation for a given operator name and dispatch key.

methods.name: Library::_parseNameForLib
methods.description: Parses an operator name string into an OperatorName object, ensuring namespace consistency.

methods.name: Library::_resolve
methods.description: Resolves a string to an OperatorName within the library context.

methods.name: Library::_fallback
methods.description: Registers a fallback function for dispatch keys, applicable globally or to specific namespaces.
